obligations.expected_behavior: Independently verify that the requested target conforms to the supported target rules.
forbidden_result: The target is treated as valid without independent verification.
obligations.observable_result: An independent verification result records whether the target satisfies the supported target rules.
obligations.state_after: Supported-target-rule conformance is independently established or rejected.
obligations.state_before: A target request is under evaluation and supported-target-rule conformance has not yet been independently established.
obligations.subject: Supported target rules
obligations.trigger: When a target request is inspected.

obligations.expected_behavior: Independently verify the effective inspection identity associated with the target request.
forbidden_result: The effective inspection identity is accepted without independent verification.
obligations.observable_result: An independent verification result records the effective inspection identity used for the request.
obligations.state_after: The effective inspection identity is independently established and associated with the inspection result.
obligations.state_before: A target request is under evaluation and its effective inspection identity has not yet been independently established.
obligations.subject: Effective inspection identity
obligations.trigger: When a target request is inspected.

obligations.expected_behavior: Reject a request with a missing target so it cannot complete successfully.
forbidden_result: The missing-target request is accepted or execution succeeds.
obligations.observable_result: The request is denied with a missing-target outcome and no successful completion is produced.
obligations.state_after: The missing-target request has failed and cannot succeed.
obligations.state_before: A request is presented without the required target.
obligations.subject: Missing targets

obligations.expected_behavior: Reject a request with an illegal target so it cannot complete successfully.

obligations.observable_result: The request is denied with an illegal-target outcome and no successful completion is produced.
obligations.state_after: The illegal-target request has failed and cannot succeed.
obligations.state_before: A request is presented with a target that violates target legality rules.
obligations.subject: Illegal targets

obligations.expected_behavior: Reject a request with an unsupported target so it cannot complete successfully.
forbidden_result: The unsupported-target request is accepted or execution succeeds.
obligations.observable_result: The request is denied with an unsupported-target outcome and no successful completion is produced.
obligations.state_after: The unsupported-target request has failed and cannot succeed.
obligations.state_before: A request is presented with a target outside the supported target set.
obligations.subject: Unsupported targets

forbidden_result: The escaping-target request is accepted or execution succeeds.
obligations.observable_result: The request is denied with an escaping-target outcome and no successful completion is produced.
obligations.state_after: The escaping-target request has failed and cannot succeed.
obligations.state_before: A request is presented with a target that resolves outside the permitted target boundary.
obligations.subject: Escaping targets
obligations.trigger: When target resolution escapes the permitted boundary.

obligations.expected_behavior: Reject a request whose target does not match the required or inspected target identity so it cannot complete successfully.
forbidden_result: The wrong-target request is accepted or execution succeeds.
obligations.observable_result: The request is denied with a wrong-target outcome and no successful completion is produced.

obligations.state_before: A request is presented whose target does not match the required target or effective inspection identity.
obligations.subject: Wrong targets
obligations.trigger: When the supplied target is mismatched.
